items.title: Truist: Pay With Paze & Get $10 off $20 (Limit 1)
items.why: Wallet-linked spend bonuses on mainstream bank cards are a low-cost way to push checkout adoption.
items.summary_ai: Truist customers can earn a $10 statement credit for a $20 purchase made with Paze checkout.
items.take: Wallet-linked spend bonuses on mainstream bank cards are a low-cost way to push checkout adoption.
